environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'platform-services' with a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP exposed via an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. The NLB forwards raw TCP to the pod on port 8080. No ingress controller or HTTP-aware proxy sits between external clients and the pod. The pod's ServiceAccount has no network policy restrictions. The NLB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080.
